question: Mevi Oil company founded year founding location and headquarters address
markdown:
Aceitera Mevi México (part of the Mevi Avocado Group
, which manufactures extra virgin avocado oil) was founded in 1974 in Mexico
. It maintains headquarters in
Guadalajara, Jalisco, Mexico
, with primary operational and facility location near Carretera Ciudad Guzmán a Zapotiltic Km 2+800, Huescalapa, 49616 Zapotiltic, Jalisco, Mexico.
